## Natural history notes

A small crambid moth characterized by narrow, satiny white to pale cream wings with subtle tan or golden markings, giving it a milky, delicate appearance. In Florida, it is found in grassy open habitats such as prairies, lawns, roadsides, marsh edges, fields, and other areas where grasses and low vegetation are common. Adults are mostly nocturnal and may come to lights, while the caterpillars likely feed on grasses or related herbaceous plants, helping connect low vegetation with nocturnal moth and insect food webs.
